## Your opportunity

  

At Schwab, you’re empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us challenge the status quo and transform the finance industry together. We believe in the importance of in-office collaboration and fully intend for the selected candidate for this role to work on site in the specified location(s).

As a Platform Support Data Engineer on the SAMS Technology team, you will play a critical role in ensuring the resiliency, stability, and performance of enterprise data platforms that support key business capabilities across Schwab. Working within a collaborative and highly technical environment, you will partner with engineers, developers, and business stakeholders to support and optimize database platforms, deployment pipelines, and application environments while helping drive continuous improvement through automation and modern DevOps practices.

In this role, you will contribute to the reliability and operational excellence of applications and services by troubleshooting complex production-support challenges, improving platform performance, implementing monitoring solutions, and identifying opportunities to reduce manual effort through automation. You will help maintain and enhance database environments, support application releases, and influence operational best practices that improve system availability, scalability, and efficiency.

Success in this position requires strong analytical thinking, adaptability, and a passion for solving challenging technical problems. You will leverage your experience supporting enterprise applications and database technologies to drive meaningful outcomes, collaborate across teams, and help deliver secure, reliable, and high-performing technology solutions that support Schwab's commitment to innovation and client-centric service.

## What you have

  

Required Qualifications

* 3+ years of experience supporting enterprise applications, software deployment pipelines, database platforms, or related technology environments.
* 3+ years of experience performing database administration, database troubleshooting, performance tuning, or database operations activities.
* Experience supporting software releases, release engineering processes, and application configuration management.
* Experience implementing automation solutions and supporting DevOps practices that improve operational efficiency and system reliability.
* Experience monitoring applications and platforms and using operational metrics to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve issues.
* Knowledge of software development lifecycles, infrastructure technologies, databases, operating systems, networking, and application support best practices.
* Experience working in Agile environments and partnering effectively with Agile development teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to quickly understand complex systems and architectures.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with SQL Server, Oracle, and PostgreSQL database administration, migration, monitoring, performance tuning, and recovery processes.
* Experience with CI/CD tools and platforms such as Jenkins, GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, Jira, or Confluence.
* Experience supporting cloud-based platforms and Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) technologies.
* Experience with Splunk, AppDynamics, or similar observability and monitoring platforms.
* Experience administering or troubleshooting Linux and Windows environments.
* Knowledge of ITIL problem management and operational support practices.
* Experience supporting third-party vendor applications and SaaS platforms.
* Experience within the financial services, banking, or highly regulated industry.
* Experience establishing database backup, recovery, and capacity planning strategies.

In addition to the salary range, this role is eligible for bonus or incentive opportunities.Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without employer sponsorship.

  

## What’s in it for you

At Schwab, you’re empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our [Hybrid Work and Flexibility](https://www.schwabjobs.com/hybrid-work) approach balances our ongoing commitment to workplace flexibility, serving our clients, and our strong belief in the value of being together in person on a regular basis.

We offer a competitive [benefits package](https://www.schwabjobs.com/summary-of-benefits) that takes care of the whole you – both today and in the future:

* 401(k) with company match and Employee stock purchase plan
* Paid time for vacation, volunteering, and 28-day sabbatical after every 5 years of service for eligible positions
* Paid parental leave and family building benefits
* Tuition reimbursement
* Health, dental, and vision insurance

As a Data Engineer on our Business Data Platform (BDP) team, you will own the operational backbone of our data infrastructure and help lead our Secure Data Initiative — the company's active program to mature role-based access, tag-based masking, and governance across the platform. You will play a critical role in ensuring resilient, secure, and scalable systems that power analytics, AI, experimentation, and business decision-making across the company. This role bridges platform engineering, data governance, and DevOps—enabling seamless data delivery and access with leading-class observability and compliance.

- Own the design, build, and maintenance of AppFolio's Business Data Platform's observability and testing solutions that identify reliability, scalability, or data quality issues and strive to continuously improve the platform.

- Own the CI/CD architecture for our Github repositories — build the automated checks, deployment pipelines, and orchestration that every team's changes run through, and keep that platform running as new teams and use cases plug into it.

- Own the creation of and performance of Data Pipeline SLOs.

- Create and enforce data access controls, masking policies, and encryption standards (at rest and in transit).

- Maintain lineage and metadata documentation across key data domains.

- Implement and manage infrastructure-as-code for data platform components.

- Drive automation of routine operations (e.g., environment provisioning, credential rotation, usage monitoring).

- Partner with data engineers, data science engineers, data scientists, and analysts to improve platform usability and self-service capabilities.

- Document and evangelize best practices for data access, job orchestration, and environment management.

- Proficiency in data engineering tools and technologies - SQL, Python, Airflow, Mulesoft, Linux scripting, and dbt

- Strong Experience with cloud technology, especially AWS tech stack (s3, ec2, eks), Docker and Kubernetes

- Experience with cloud data warehouse technology, such as Snowflake, including data security and governance

**Overview**  
  

This is a remote role that may only be hired in the following location(s): North Carolina, Arizona, Texas and Florida.

We are seeking a Lead Data Engineer with deep, hands-on experience designing, building, and operating production-grade data platforms. This role is targeted at senior engineers who have personally implemented end-to-end data pipelines and can mentor junior engineers through example. The Lead Data Engineer will be responsible not only for delivery, but also for setting engineering standards, patterns, and best practices across the data platform.

This is a highly technical role. Candidates must have real-world, production experience with modern ELT architectures, Snowflake, dbt, Qlik Replicate, Python-based pipeline development, and cloud-native services.

This role is expected to help shape the future-state engineering model for the organization, including the application of automation, intelligent systems, and AI-enabled capabilities that accelerate modernization efforts, simplify delivery processes, and transform how engineering work is performed.

  
**Responsibilities & Qualifications**  
  

**Duties & Responsibilities:**

**End-to-End Data Pipeline Ownership**

* Design, build, and operate data pipelines using Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold).  
    • Own ingestion, transformation, governance, testing, and publishing layers.  
    • Ensure reliability, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency of pipelines.

**Data Ingestion & Integration**

* Implement CDC and batch ingestion using Qlik Replicate.  
    • Design ingestion patterns for databases, files, and APIs.  
    • Build reusable Python-based pipeline components and frameworks.

**Transformation, Modeling & Testing**

* Develop dbt models using advanced SQL and Jinja templating.  
    • Implement automated testing for data quality, schema validation, and freshness.  
    • Enable CI/CD-driven transformation deployments.

**Snowflake Platform Engineering & Governance**

* Implement Snowpipe, Tasks, Streams, and Stored Procedures.  
    • Design and enforce RBAC, dynamic masking, and tag-based access control.  
    • Ensure data security and compliance through platform-level controls.

**Cloud Engineering**

* Build and deploy data components using AWS services such as S3, Lambda, ECS Fargate, Glue, DynamoDB, and IAM, or equivalent Azure services.  
    • Collaborate on CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and environment promotion.

**Architecture**

* Demonstrated success implementing automation, reusable frameworks, platform capabilities, or engineering operating models that materially improve delivery speed, engineering productivity, quality, reliability, or operational efficiency.
* Experience identifying and implementing opportunities to reduce manual effort across software delivery, data delivery, testing, operations, governance, and platform management processes.

**Leadership & Mentorship**

* Serve as a technical leader and mentor junior and mid-level data engineers.  
    • Lead design discussions, code reviews, and technical decision-making.  
    • Establish and enforce engineering best practices and standards.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Qualified candidates will have proven, hands-on production experience with most of the following:

* Designing and operating Medallion Architecture data pipelines  
    • Data ingestion using Qlik Replicate (CDC and batch)  
    • Custom Python data pipeline development  
    • dbt Mesh Architecture experience  
    • dbt Cloud transformations, testing, SQL, and Jinja templating  
    • Snowflake ingestion and platform features (Snowpipe, Tasks, Stored Procedures)  
    • Data governance in Snowflake including RBAC, Tokenization, and dynamic data masking  
    • Release management, code deployment, disaster recovery activities  
    • Cloud development using AWS or equivalent Azure services
* Experience leading engineering transformation initiatives involving AI-enabled delivery, intelligent automation, workflow orchestration, knowledge automation, engineering productivity acceleration, or large-scale delivery lifecycle modernization.

**Education & Experience**

Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 6 years of experience in Advanced Data Engineering, data technologies, cloud platforms, and project or technical leadership

High School Diploma or GED and a minimum of 10 years of experience in Advanced Data Engineering, data technologies, cloud platforms, and project or technical leadership

* Data Governance, Security & Quality Management - Establish and enforce data governance policies, best practices and implement data quality checks, standardization. Enforce Snowflake RBAC/ABAC, network policies/rules, masking/row access policies, tags, data classification, and least-privilege role hierarchies.
* Data warehousing & modeling - Build performant Snowflake objects (databases, tables, streams, tasks, materialized views, warehouses) and optimize clustering/micro-partitioning
* Performance Optimization and Troubleshooting - Analyze and optimize system performance for large-scale data operations. Troubleshoot complex data issues and implement robust solutions

* Testing – Validate snowflake data objects, roles, RBAC policies, configurations, integrations, access.
* Code Deployment & Release Management - Adopt release management processes to promote code deployment to various environments including production, disaster recovery, and support activities.
* Mentorship and Knowledge Sharing - Mentor junior data engineers and provide technical guidance. Contribute to the development of best practices and standards. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive data literacy

* Snowflake data security and governance strategies – Okta/SailPoint integration, RBAC, masking, data classification, tokenization, lineage.

This is a remote role that may be hired in several markets across the United States. Priority given to those candidates located in the area of **Raleigh, North Carolina, Phoenix, Arizona and Dallas,Texas**.
